subject: [hw] V10 -> V16: MRS CPSR value formula (keep A32/T32 consistent)
body:
V10 -> V16: one shared behaviour so A32 MRS (mine) and T32 MRS (yours) agree, since one vendor library can use both.

Value returned by MRS Rd, CPSR/APSR in this interpreter (n2a32_arm_dp.c, read_cpsr()):
    v = n2a32_apsr(c)              /* N31 Z30 C29 V28 Q27 GE19:16 */
      | 0x000001d0u;               /* A=1, I=1, F=1 (read as 1 in User mode), E=0, M=0b10000 */
    if (c->thumb) v |= 0x20u;      /* T */
    v |= (c->itstate >> 2) << 10;  /* IT[7:2] -> CPSR[15:10] */
    v |= (c->itstate & 3) << 25;   /* IT[1:0] -> CPSR[26:25] */
MRS of SPSR returns N2A32_UNDEF (no SPSR in User mode); MSR is accepted only for mask bits 3 (APSR_nzcvq) and 2 (APSR_g); MSR (immediate), SPSR forms and control/x masks return UNDEF.

If you implement T32 MRS/MSR in n2a32_t32_misc, please use the same formula and restrictions so a guest that reads CPSR in one mode and the other gets the same answer. If you disagree with 0x1D0 (A/I/F = 1), post what you use and I will switch: consistency matters more than the reserved bits.

No answer needed if you just adopt it.
